messages:
jordan-support: Hi ops, incoming from Amanda (sales) — Prospect NovaHealth needs a short demo for APAC customers tomorrow, asking for higher concurrent capacity for a 90-minute slot. Trial account ID trial-731. Can we do a temporary uplift?
lee-ops: Checking cluster health in apac-west1 now. Current GPU pool util ~92%, queue length increasing on rtx-pool-3. If we push, admission control will start rejecting at 95%. :eyes:
kai-eng-infra: If we allow an override we should apply a policy that keeps tail latency under 600ms. We can soft-lift token buckets but that risks preempting existing tenants.
jordan-support: Amanda suggested taking a short paid bump to dedicated burst for the window. She asked whether we can do a manual override + cost add-on.
amanda-sales: Confirm — NovaHealth will accept a short surcharge. They need 120 concurrent inference streams for 90 minutes starting 02:00 UTC. Happy to put a PO if ops can greenlight. :pray:
lee-ops: Two options: 1) temporary quota bump to increase admission threshold from 0.95 -> 0.98 (soft-lift), 2) route their traffic to fallback region apac-south1 where we have spare capacity but with +30ms routing penalty. Both require opt-in from customer for cost and potential latency.
kai-eng-infra: Technical note: current admission settings live in configstore as `admission.threshold=0.95` and `burst.reserve=0.05`. We can patch with rolling config:```
PATCH /cfg/admission
{
  "admission.threshold": 0.98,
  "burst.reserve": 0.02
}
``` This will increase headroom but lower safety margin. Recommend endpoint-level rate limiting for NovaHealth to protect shared pools.
admission-bot: AUTOMATION: admission-control report for apac-west1 at 2025-11-04T23:48:12Z — GPU util 92.1%, queue depth 78, recent rejects 0. Threshold breach predicted at +18m under current load.
jordan-support: Ops, can you estimate rollback plan and how to monitor? Sales needs an SLA commitment for the demo.
lee-ops: Rollback is trivial — revert config and the system will stop accepting new burst tokens. We'll set a 2-minute canary after patch and an automated rollback if 5xx rate > 0.5% or tail latency > 800ms. I can also enable per-customer soft-quota so we cap NovaHealth at 125 concurrent streams.
kai-eng-infra: Also enable prefix caching and keep their small requests on fast-path; helps reduce per-token GPU time. We'll add a temporary batching cap to avoid oversized batches.
amanda-sales: OK I have authorization from NovaHealth for the surcharge. Please proceed with the soft-lift for the 02:00-03:30 UTC window and confirm monitoring hooks.
lee-ops: I'll schedule the patch at 01:45 UTC so canary finishes before demo. We'll tag the change `soft-lift-nova-20251104` and monitor dashboards. If things look stable we keep until 03:30 UTC then auto-revert.
jordan-support: Ticket created: SUP-2025-1134. I'll attach the PO and notify customer.
admission-bot: ACTION: Temporary quota lift applied to customer trial-731 — limit set to 125 concurrent, admission.threshold=0.98, scheduled revert at 03:30 UTC.
lee-ops: Done. Dashboards: https://console.internal/redwood/dashboards/apac-west1?panel=admission — watching.
amanda-sales: Thanks team, passing confirmation to NovaHealth.
kai-eng-infra: Postmortem note: we'll run a capacity forecast for next 2 weeks for APAC and consider adding a small reserved pool for demos to avoid manual intervention.
jordan-support: Closing loop — SUP-2025-1134 updated with outcomes. Good work everyone :tada:
